nodes.label: icons.svg SVG Icon Sprite
nodes.summary: SVG sprite with 6 reusable symbols: Bluesky, Discord, GitHub, X brand icons plus documentation and social outline icons. Purpose is shared UI icon set referenced via <use> for social links, docs links, and community affordances.

nodes.label: bluesky-icon symbol
nodes.summary: Bluesky butterfly brand glyph, dark fill, viewBox 0 0 16 17 with clipPath.

nodes.label: discord-icon symbol
nodes.summary: Discord brand glyph, dark fill, viewBox 0 0 20 19.

nodes.label: documentation-icon symbol
nodes.summary: Documentation outline icon in purple stroke, code brackets plus document shape, viewBox 0 0 21 20.

nodes.label: github-icon symbol
nodes.summary: GitHub Octocat mark, dark fill, viewBox 0 0 19 19.

nodes.label: social-icon symbol
nodes.summary: Social outline icon in purple stroke, person plus star badge, viewBox 0 0 20 20.

nodes.label: x-icon symbol
nodes.summary: X brand glyph, dark fill, viewBox 0 0 19 19.
